name: RoadPrintz Electra100
summary: Truck-mounted robotic system that lays out and paints detail road markings such as turn arrows, stop bars, crosswalks and words without stencils. A Yaskawa industrial robot arm on a Ford F-550 paints while the single operator stays in the cab and controls it from a touchscreen.

germany.statusNote: Sold and rented from the USA; customers in Canada and Mexico are served from the US. The maker says it is looking for partners in the EU but names none, so there is no German or EU sales route yet.

specs.label: Generation
specs.quote: Our current model, Electra100, is a fourth generation system designed to robotically put down detail pavement markings.

specs.label: Carrier vehicle
specs.quote: Our robotic painting system is built on the proven Ford F550 commercial truck platform

specs.label: Robot arm
specs.value: Yaskawa industrial robot arm, paints across an entire lane
specs.quote: The most unique feature of the system is a Yaskawa industrial robotic arm.  The robot easily paints across an entire lane.

specs.label: Symbol library
specs.conditions: turn arrows, stop bars, ONLY, BUS and more; up to 5 custom symbols in the first year
specs.quote: Our System comes with a library of over 45 MUTCD symbols including turn arrows, stop bars, ONLY, BUS, and many more

specs.label: Time to paint a turn arrow
specs.quote: A turn arrow takes less than 3 minutes to paint.

specs.label: Paint capacity
specs.conditions: plus glass bead tank and water flushing tank
specs.quote: The RoadPrintz system holds up to five 5-gallon paint buckets.  The robot is able to switch between two paint sources.

specs.label: Marking materials
specs.value: waterborne latex, solvent-based acrylic and chalk-based temporary paints
specs.quote: The robotic detail pavement marking system uses waterborne latex traffic paints, solvent-based acrylic traffic paints and chalk based temporary marking paints.

specs.label: Operators
specs.conditions: a following support vehicle is recommended
specs.quote: A single operator can drive to the location, paint the symbol and place traffic cones on the pavement without exiting the truck cab.

specs.label: Safety
specs.value: four hard-wired e-stops, one portable remote e-stop, LiDAR work-zone monitoring
specs.quote: Besides being equipped with four hard-wired Emergency Stops and one portable remote E-Stop, the system includes a LiDAR-based workzone safety system which automatically halts the robot when any intrusion into the workzone is detected.

specs.label: Purchase terms
specs.value: 50 % deposit, balance on delivery; delivery and taxes extra
specs.conditions: price on request; rental also offered

notes: Paints transverse and detail markings (symbols, legends, crosswalks, bike lanes), not long lines along the kerb (maker FAQ).
Also helps with layout, logs the position and heading of each symbol and the paint and bead use, and can set out traffic cones; it does not pick them up.
Layout and painting can be done at night (maker).
specialisedFor uses layout_marking because the system lays out and paints road markings; there is no road-marking job id.

images.alt: White RoadPrintz Ford truck with a blue robot arm at the rear painting a green bike-lane marking on a street

evidence.task: Paints crosswalks in live traffic from the truck, no crew on the road
evidence.note: Maker video and customer quotes from road crews in Cleveland, Houston and St. Louis on the maker homepage.
